summary: Classic Buzz 3-band EQ: low, mid and high gains of ±24 dB with two crossover frequencies. For broad tone shaping; Neo EQ is the precise one.
quirks: Mono out (the profile measured an output correlation of 1.0), and about 6 dB louder than its input at unity settings: ReBuzz feeds a mono native effect left + right summed (ReBuzz/NativeMachine/NativeMessage.cs). Profile: +6.0 dB at the defaults.
The bands are split by Low Cutoff and High Cutoff: the mid band is everything between them.
Gains near their top are hot: +18.8 dBFS with Mid or High Gain at +24 dB on noise (profile).
Closed source: names and units come from its own descriptions and texts.
